name: input_clearable
title: Input Clearable
description: A text field with a clear button that only appears when the field has a value.

classes.name: input--clearable
classes.description: Hides the clear button while the input shows its placeholder, and hides the browser's own search cancel button. Use it with input and input--actor. The inner input needs a placeholder.

attributes.name: data-input-clearable-action="clear"
attributes.description: Clears the field and focuses it.

actions.name: clear
actions.description: Empties the field and moves focus back to it.
